Your information

Your privacy

A clear explanation of how this website handles enquiries and links to other services.

✳

On this page

Your décor preview photosThe details you enterReviewing and sendingExternal servicesHosting and technical informationImages and client informationQuestions about your information
01

Your décor preview photos

The décor try-on editor processes venue and decoration photographs in your browser. Photos are not sent to OpenAI or stored by the website. AI background-removal models are downloaded from IMG.LY, which may receive routine request metadata when delivering those files. Download your result before clearing the studio or leaving the page.

02

The details you enter

With your consent, the enquiry form saves your name, contact number, event preferences and optional details in our Supabase database so the authorised Purple Fox team can follow up. The form also prepares a WhatsApp draft. Enquiry data is visible only to authorised administrators and may be exported for event coordination. Contact us to request a correction or deletion. We retain details only for as long as needed to handle your enquiry and event arrangements.

03

Reviewing and sending

When you continue, WhatsApp opens with the prepared message. You can review, edit or choose not to send it. If you send it, the details are shared directly with Purple Fox through WhatsApp. Avoid including information that is unnecessary for your event enquiry.

04

External services

WhatsApp and Instagram are operated by their respective providers. Their own privacy terms and account settings apply when you follow a link or use those services. Google Fonts is used to load the website’s typography.

05

Hosting and technical information

The hosting provider may process routine request information, such as IP addresses and browser information, to deliver and secure the website. This website does not add advertising trackers or visitor analytics.

06

Images and client information

AI-generated styling concepts are labelled separately from event photographs uploaded by our team. Uploaded photographs are published only with permission. Published photographs are publicly accessible; private contact and planning records are not published.

07

Questions about your information

For a question about an enquiry or information you have shared directly with Purple Fox, contact the team on WhatsApp at +91 70755 05617. Our private admin dashboard is restricted to authorised team members. Visitors cannot browse saved enquiries. WhatsApp requests record a submitted contact request, not confirmation that a WhatsApp message was sent.

Need a little clarity?

We’re happy to discuss questions about your enquiry.
